description: A ruined stone-brick building fragment from the Moss Ruins datapack (city/buildings set) — mossy, broken-walled, in the same Mediterranean-ruin idiom as the admitted hero temple pieces.

style_fit.rationale: Carries a legacy `minecraft:grass` id and DataVersion 2975 (MC 1.18.2). `grass` was renamed to `short_grass` in 1.20.3, so the piece needs a real DataFixerUpper upgrade pass, not just a render-check, before it is safe to admit; the palette audit's still-valid ids do not cover a silently-renamed one. Deferred until the converter runs a proper DFU migration.
